units.title: Cover a square grid with k monotone paths
units.statement: For 1≤k<n, each up-or-right path from the lower-left to upper-right cell meets every northeast diagonal exactly once. Since the diagonals have sizes 1,2,...,n-1,n,n-1,...,1, at least sum(max(0,size-k))=(n-k)^2 cells remain uncovered. This bound is attained by the lower/right boundary route together with k−1 nested L-shaped routes indexed i=0,...,k−2: move right i, up n−1−i, right n−1−i, and up i.
steps: Count cells on each fixed-coordinate-sum diagonal
Bound visits on each diagonal by k
Use boundary and nested L-shaped routes to attain the bound
